decisions.reason: The offshore and renewables management unit sits close to BSM's core competence and draws on existing crew and management resources, so it costs little to keep. Offshore wind is growing, so the option still has upside and should stay open.

Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on the firm's large seafarer pool. It needs little extra investment, and crew travel demand recovered after the pandemic, so there is no evidence to justify abandoning it.

The online vessel portal is a flagship digital option tied to customer service and transparency. Its running costs are modest and its value in maritime digitalisation is still unfolding, so keeping it is preferable.

The mobile performance app supports the firm's sustainability direction, but it is more peripheral and may be folded into the portal. With no negative evidence and low maintenance cost, the option is kept for now.
